carriedBy.title: a_member_removed_during_the_poll_promotes_nothing
carriedBy.proves: A member removed while their poll waits on a page ends the cycle as Retry, and none of that member's posts is served.

entries.reason: Replaced by the named Rust test (a member removed during a poll promotes nothing); the October driver held pages and detected a terminal page by a body commit and waited for a log word that no longer exists, so it cannot pass on any current build.

carriedBy.title: a_generation_bumped_between_the_read_and_the_promotion_is_unauthorized
carriedBy.proves: A promotion whose member generation was reset after the target was read is refused as unauthorized and writes no record or post.

carriedBy.title: a_member_who_left_cannot_be_promoted
carriedBy.proves: A promotion for a member removed after the target was read is refused as unauthorized.

entries.reason: Replaced by the named Rust tests. A November poll verifies and promotes the commit of its last page, so a removal during that last read is a removal before the promotion write, and the store refuses that write after a generation reset and after a removal; the October driver held pages and detected a terminal page by a body commit and waited for a log word that no longer exists, so it cannot pass on any current build.

carriedBy.title: a_departed_member_loses_the_verified_state_and_the_other_member_keeps_it
carriedBy.proves: Removing one of two promoted members deletes that member's verified state and stored paths and leaves the other member's.

carriedBy.title: a_member_who_left_cannot_be_replaced
carriedBy.proves: After one member is removed, the other member's post, boundary, interaction and verified-state rows are unchanged, and a replacement for the removed member is refused.

entries.reason: Replaced by the named Rust tests (a departed member's rows go and another member's stay). The other member of the October driver held Stratos custody; the named tests keep another PDS-custody member, and the journey runs the mixed case against a host. The October driver held pages and detected a terminal page by a body commit and waited for a log word that no longer exists, so it cannot pass on any current build.

carriedBy.title: a_stale_generation_changes_nothing
carriedBy.proves: After a member is removed and added again, a replacement under the old generation is refused as unauthorized and changes no row.

carriedBy.title: reading_the_base_under_a_stale_generation_is_refused
carriedBy.proves: Reading a member's base with a generation other than the current one is refused as unauthorized.

carriedBy.title: a_member_re_enrolled_with_a_new_generation_starts_with_a_replacement
carriedBy.proves: A member removed and added again while a poll waits ends that poll as Retry, and a cycle holding the old generation is turned away at its first base read.

entries.reason: Replaced by the named Rust tests (the generation is checked at each store write and at each base read). The October run also waited for a logged target failure; a stale cycle now ends as Retry, which is not a failure. The October driver held pages and detected a terminal page by a body commit and waited for a log word that no longer exists, so it cannot pass on any current build.

carriedBy.title: a_member_re_enrolled_with_a_new_generation_starts_with_a_replacement
carriedBy.proves: After the stale cycle is refused, the next cycle replaces the member's state under a new generation and its digest equals the host's.

entries.reason: Replaced by the named Rust tests (a member added again starts with a replacement under a new generation); the October driver held pages and detected a terminal page by a body commit and waited for a log word that no longer exists, so it cannot pass on any current build.

carriedBy.title: a_member_who_left_stays_gone_and_cannot_be_replaced_after_the_store_reopens
carriedBy.proves: A member removed from a file store has no generation, base or rows after the store is closed and reopened, the other member's rows are unchanged, and a replacement for the removed member is refused.

entries.reason: Replaced by the named Rust test, which closes and reopens a real encrypted file store after the removal, where the October driver restarted the feed generator; the October driver held pages and detected a terminal page by a body commit and waited for a log word that no longer exists, so it cannot pass on any current build.

carriedBy.title: pages_of_one_cycle_draw_on_the_same_budget
carriedBy.proves: One value budget charged by three equal pages refuses the third once two have used it, and its used count does not reset between pages.

entries.reason: Replaced by the named Rust test. The October budget accumulated over passes because staged pages carried from one pass to the next; a November cycle carries nothing into the next, so the budget a split read cannot evade is the one every page of a cycle draws on. Staging no longer exists, so the October assertion about stage accounting cannot pass on any current build.
Superseded, nothing to port to: it measured staged-page accounting or expiry, and staging no longer exists, so it cannot pass on any current build.

carriedBy.title: a_page_past_the_decoded_value_budget_fails_and_one_at_it_is_accepted
carriedBy.proves: A poll whose page decodes one value past the budget fails as RepoOverBudget and changes no table, and one at the budget is promoted.

carriedBy.title: an_archive_over_a_limit_fails_as_over_budget_and_changes_nothing
carriedBy.proves: A whole-repo archive with more records or bytes than allowed fails the cycle as RepoOverBudget and leaves every table as it was.

entries.reason: Replaced by the named Rust test of the budget, deadline or interruption it exercised; staging no longer exists, so the October assertion about stage accounting cannot pass on any current build.

Not covered today. The October run required a health answer within two seconds while sync was over its budget, and no current test makes a health or feed request while a sync cycle runs. The health handler reads the readiness gate and the scheduler status, not the store; a test would hold a store write open, request /health, and require an answer within that bound. Until one exists only the named journey of the prepared suite carries it.

carriedBy.title: a_promotion_that_never_commits_leaves_nothing_and_a_full_one_survives_reopening
carriedBy.proves: A promotion dropped before its commit leaves no base, record, post or interaction on a reopened file store, and a full promotion afterwards survives another reopen.

carriedBy.title: a_replacement_that_never_commits_leaves_the_earlier_state_and_a_full_one_survives_reopening
carriedBy.proves: A replacement dropped before its commit leaves the earlier verified rows on a reopened file store, and a full replacement afterwards survives another reopen.

entries.reason: The behaviour is inverted on purpose, and the named Rust tests pin the inverted behaviour, not the October one. The October feed generator kept the staged cursor of an interrupted pass to resume from; the November one stages nothing, so an interrupted cycle must leave nothing and the next cycle starts from the verified base. Staging no longer exists, so the October assertion cannot pass on any current build.
Superseded, nothing to port to: it measured staged-page accounting or expiry, and staging no longer exists, so it cannot pass on any current build.
